detail: Repaint this separated floating rock golem atlas with living multicolored minerals and a bioluminescent mineral core. Keep every existing glowing fissure/core location and rock plate silhouette unchanged. Rock plates show indigo blue, amethyst violet, cyan, and warm ivory layered mineral bands, dense fine geode rings, tiny crystal cleavage, pale moss crust, antique gold mineral flecks. Fine cyan and rose veins trace existing cracks, large ivory quartz rock planes alternate with deeper blue rock planes. Dark crevices stay dark; glow locations stay exactly fixed. Organic enchanted garden geology with detailed worn stone, material separation essential, no uniform purple or single hue glow wash.
